object.attr: derived: CF-V62 (D-V40). The merge's paths come from another clone, and a crafted one, with .., a backslash, a drive or .git, could place a git hook. MELLON-STORE-SRS-228 and -230 cover other writes and reads. Accepted on 2026-11-13 as a security fix after the code view (CV-VER-35: resolving a merge wrote paths read from the other branch without checking them); to confirm with the person (open question Q20).
object.description: When Mellon resolves a merge, Mellon shall write only files inside a document folder, with names that the on-disk format defines.
